shellCommands.command: echo "=== docs dir ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== app structure ==="; find . -maxdepth 4 -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | sort; echo "=== package.json ==="; cat package.json
grep -rli "view.transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null

node -e "const r = require('/workspace/node_modules/react/index.js'); console.log(typeof r.ViewTransition, Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|Transition/i.test(k)))" 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "---version---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -rl "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/ 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "---"
find /workspace/node_modules -maxdepth 2 -iname "react" -type d 2>/dev/null
echo "---experimental check---"
node -e "const r = require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js'); console.log(typeof r.ViewTransition)" 2>&1
echo "---package resolution---"
node -e "console.log(require.resolve('react', {paths:['/workspace/node_modules/next']}))" 2>&1
grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -50

lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; nohup npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 & disown
timeout 40 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && echo READY || (echo FAILED; cat /tmp/nextdev.log)
which chromium-cli || echo "not found"
node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1; echo "---"; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1; echo "---"; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*chromium-cli*" 2>/dev/null

find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "playwright*" -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules/.cache; echo "---"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; echo "---npm registry check---"; timeout 8 npm view playwright version 2>&1
cd /tmp && mkdir -p pwtest && cd pwtest && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install playwright@1.62.1 >/tmp/pwinstall.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -20 /tmp/pwinstall.log
cd /tmp/pwtest && npx playwright install chromium --with-deps >/tmp/pwbrowser.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -40 /tmp/pwbrowser.log
cd /tmp/pwtest && npx playwright install chromium >/tmp/pwbrowser2.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -20 /tmp/pwbrowser2.log
cd /tmp/pwtest && node drive.mjs 2>&1

cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; which apt apt-get yum dnf apk microdnf 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find / -xdev -iname "libnspr4*" 2>/dev/null; find / -xdev -iname "libnss3*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
id; echo "---"; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo "have passwordless sudo" || echo "no passwordless sudo"
sudo dnf install -y nss nspr atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon at-spi2-atk mesa-libgbm alsa-lib pango cairo libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr libxshmfence 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /tmp/pwtest && node drive.mjs 2>&1
cd /tmp/pwtest && node drive2.mjs 2>&1

pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3000 || echo "port 3000 free"; rm -rf /tmp/pwtest /tmp/pwinstall.log /tmp/pwbrowser.log /tmp/pwbrowser2.log /tmp/nextdev.log
git status --short
git status --short
git diff tsconfig.json; echo "---package.json---"; git diff package.json
cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null

git checkout -- tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
git status --short
